name: Presidio (the Army's planted forest above the Golden Gate)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Presidio Golf Course, San Francisco, from the developer's photos (release assorted-lidar-data): bright, sunlit yellow-green fairways and greens; a lusher, darker rough (F0-F2); cream sand; the forest floor of pine and cypress duff (G0-G2: woods); out of bounds, the Presidio's lawns and meadow (L0-L2); the bay's blue; the Army buildings' red tile roofs (R0). Trees in assets-src/trees_presidio.py: Monterey pine, Monterey cypress, eucalyptus and live oak. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
